en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of fantasies could Himiko have?
Her whole life is fantasy.

Shuichi...is your mana attuned
properly for the ceremony?
Huh? Ah, what?

What, did you skip your preparations 
again? What a useless thrall!

Nyeeeh...why did I make a useless 
guy like you my thrall?
Your...thrall?

You still don't understand? I explained 
it when I forged the contract.
By thrall, I mean...you're my familiar.

I granted you, a magical beast, human 
form. In exchange, you serve me.
...So I'm an animal? In human form?

You've forgotten already?
You were originally a wolf.
What!? I'm a wolf!?

<CLT=cltMIND>This is pretty out there,
even for a fantasy!

<CLT=cltMIND>Is Himiko's fantasy to be an
all-powerful mage...?
So is your mana attuned yet or not?
Ah, um...I'm not done yet.

So you did skip your preparations...
This calls for a punishment.
P-Punishment!?

Don't move! If you move, I'll use my 
magic to pull out all your hair!

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko took a few bold steps toward me,
her eyebrows furrowed.

<CLT=cltMIND>What is she doing...? Am I about to
be a guinea pig for her magic?
Nyeh!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*boop*!
...What?

<CLT=cltMIND>I looked down to find Himiko
burying her face in my chest.
What...are you doing?
This is your punishment.
Whoa, hey!

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko squeezed me tight, rubbing
her forehead against my chest.
Nyeh... Nyeh, nyeeeh...

<CLT=cltMIND>She looks like a dog or cat rubbing against
their owner... It's kinda cute...

<CLT=cltMIND>N-No, wait, now is *not* the
time to be thinking that!
Ah...is this...my punishment?
That's right.

I usually spoil you. But...sometimes 
your master needs to be spoiled.

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko mumbled out,
her face still nuzzling me.

<CLT=cltMIND>It didn't sound like much of an order...
more like a child's pouting.
Hurry up...
Ah, okay...

<CLT=cltMIND>Spoil her...
Maybe...pet her head?

Nyeh!
Nnn...n, nnn...

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I was right.
...She really is like a pet.
More...

This is your punishment, so...you 
need to pet me...until I'm satisfied...

<CLT=cltMIND>More?
As in, pet...somewhere else?

<CLT=cltMIND>As if reading my mind,
Himiko whispered...
My back...

Y-Your back? Ah, I don't
know if I should, that's...

Hmph, are you going 
to disobey your master?

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, yes, that's right... It's just like
petting an animal! Nothing wrong with that!

<CLT=cltMIND>Only half-convinced, I still allowed my
hand to slide lower, down to her back.

Oooh!
Mmmmmm...

<CLT=cltMIND>She really seems to be enjoying it...
Does she like being petted?
Nnnn... Hmhm...
Hmhm... Nn, Nnnyeh...

<CLT=cltMIND>Watching Himiko respond to my petting made
me lose track of the time completely.
Nyeh...

<CLT=cltMIND>Without warning, Himiko's body went limp
and she curled up against me.
Ah! A-Are you okay?
Nyeh...

<CLT=cltMIND>I managed to catch her before she fell,
but just as I was about to set her down...
Whoa!

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko's arms sprung up to wrap around
my neck, embracing me tight.
H-Himiko!?
I know what you want, Shuichi...
...You do?

You're longing for the magical 
power I hold, aren't you?

It's...okay...
If you want to do...that...

I'm just a foolish mage who fell in 
love with her familiar...
<CLT=cltMIND>Love...?

I'm ready... If you want me...
then I'll become yours...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko's breath washed against my ear
in a seductive whisper.

<CLT=cltMIND>I felt like...I was put
under a spell...
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
